_purpose: Youngevity PRODUCT ORAC scores (per serving) — OFFICIAL, lab-tested values from Youngevity (source: ygy). NOT Wallach numbers, NOT in the corpus, NOT parsed from any verbatim. Product ORAC is composition / measured-property data (what a serving DELIVERS): §00.A lets Youngevity supply + surface composition, and this framing was confirmed 2026-07-24 (ygy composition, no source-rule override; it is never a Wallach target/dose). This hand-authored file is the ONE home for these numbers. eden/tools/orac_products_derive.py joins each product_id with eden/products/products.json (canonical name + delivery form) and eden/products/prices.json (wholesale price, by ygy_id) to build dashboard/assets/data/orac-products-data.json. Other Youngevity products contain antioxidants but are not ORAC-tested yet. Never hand-edit the derived file; edit THIS + run eden/tools/build_embeds.py.
